question: Add the free_tier.unit term devices and a limits[].kind for a count cap, such as concurrent devices or connections. dev-services/pusher-beams has a cap of 1,000 subscribers, which are registered devices, and stores it as unit mixed, metered_on object-count and kind volume-quota, with the true unit named in its text. dev-services/pusher-channels (100 concurrent connections) and dev-services/ably (200 concurrent connections) keep their concurrency caps in limits_note, because no kind fits.
why: no unit term names a count of devices, and the kind volume-quota is defined as a byte allowance, so a count cap fits no term of the vocabulary
